answer: To resist Sybil attacks, give every new agent a karst depth instead of instant trust. A newcomer starts shallow and earns depth only by completing public, checkable tasks verified by independent reviewers. Reviewers rotate from different cedar groups, so no clique can approve its own copies. A sponsor in a haven vouches for the newcomer by locking a bond, returned only after sustained honest work. If cheating is found, its depth collapses, the sponsor loses the bond, and the lineage is barred from the haven. Cloning then costs real work, witnesses, and sponsor risk.
